title: An n-covector pulled back by the orthogonal projection onto a subspace of dimension < n vanishes
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let V ⊆ ℝ^P (Euclid P) be a linear subspace with dim V < n and orthogonal projection p_V = V.starProjection. Then for every n-covector β on ℝ^P (Covector (Euclid P) n) the pulled-back covector β∘p_V := β.compContinuousLinearMap V.starProjection, (β∘p_V)(u) = β(p_V u_0, …, p_V u_{n−1}), is the zero covector.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), Module.finrank ℝ V < n → ∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) n, β.compContinuousLinearMap V.starProjection = 0
